principle: Unknown duration must not be guessed. Promotion/era eligibility may authorize duration only where cited rules evidence establishes the applicable fixed round duration or explicit round-duration vector.

abc_unified_rules_2025.title: Association of Boxing Commissions and Combative Sports — Unified Rules of Mixed Martial Arts
abc_unified_rules_2025.note: Professional rounds are five minutes; professional bouts may consist of one through five five-minute rounds.

ufc_28_modern_boundary.title: UFC Hall of Fame FAQ
ufc_28_modern_boundary.note: UFC 28 on 2000-11-17 was the first UFC event using the Unified Rules; UFC states pre-UFC-28 rules could vary by event or fight and post-UFC-28 rules were standardized.

ufcstats_time_format.title: UFCStats fight details — Alvarez vs McGregor
ufcstats_time_format.note: Provider displays Method KO/TKO, Round 2, Time 3:04, Time format 5 Rnd (5-5-5-5-5).

ufc_official_time_semantics.title: UFC 205 final results and news from NYC
ufc_official_time_semantics.note: UFC describes the same Alvarez-McGregor stoppage as second-round TKO at 3:04, establishing count-up elapsed time within the terminal round.

bellator_csac_2011.title: California State Athletic Commission — All-Access Pass, March 5, 2011
bellator_csac_2011.note: Commission account of Bellator tournament rules identifies a fourth five-minute tie-break round after the third round.

bellator_unified_rules_support_2016.title: California State Athletic Commission meeting materials — Bellator Regulatory Affairs letter
bellator_unified_rules_support_2016.note: Bellator Regulatory Affairs formally endorses ABC modifications to the Unified Rules of MMA.

bellator_launch_rounds_2008.title: Bellator Fighting Championships launch/TV announcement
bellator_launch_rounds_2008.note: Bellator season-one tournament format is described as three five-minute rounds.

one_global_mma_rules.title: ONE Championship — Global Mixed Martial Arts Rule Set
one_global_mma_rules.note: ONE MMA bouts are three five-minute rounds; World Championship MMA bouts are five five-minute rounds. Other ONE disciplines use different durations and must not be conflated with MMA.

one_early_mma_2012.title: Sherdog — ONE FC rule-change report
one_early_mma_2012.note: Documents early ONE FC MMA rules context; the change concerned soccer-kick legality, not round duration.

external_finish_time_repo_provenance.title: Canonical external MMA builder provenance
external_finish_time_repo_provenance.note: Builder records source M:SS as elapsed seconds within finish round.

rulesets.notes: Pre-UFC-28 bouts are intentionally outside this ruleset because UFC states their rules could vary by event or fight.

rulesets.bout_scope: Canonical Bellator professional MMA rows in the frozen external snapshot
rulesets.notes: Tournament format changed round count in some eras, but cited evidence keeps round duration at five minutes. Canonical external rows do not carry scheduled_rounds, so decision-duration eligibility remains fail-closed.

rulesets.bout_scope: Canonical ONE professional MMA rows in the frozen pro-MMA external snapshot; not ONE Muay Thai, kickboxing, submission grappling, or hybrid special-rules contests
rulesets.notes: The canonical source is explicitly a professional MMA dataset. Promotion name alone must never authorize non-MMA ONE disciplines.
